title: Honest Intervals and Sign Detection for Individualized Quantile Effects at Arbitrary Loadings
banked_reason: D0.5.G tier subfield below mandatory field floor; math review remains REVISE on Gaussian-envelope scope, so the unconditional matched lower-bound claims are uncertified.
gap_reasons: Delivered tier subfield < floor field; not salvageable within scope.

missing-envelope-condition@lem:legal-mixtures: The lemma is unconditional but invokes lem:gaussian-membership, whose Gaussian subexperiment is a member only under the four Gaussian-admissibility envelope assumptions; these are not member properties of def:model-class nor hypotheses of this lemma, so its claimed prior support in P_n (and hence its TV lower construction) is not established for every stated public envelope.

lower-bound-scope@thm:interval-lower-bound: This all-procedure lower bound applies the unconditional legal-mixtures claim; explicitly condition the theorem/frontier on Gaussian-compatible envelopes (or supply a lower submodel for arbitrary allowed envelopes).
lower-bound-scope@thm:sign-detection-frontier: Its converse (S2) likewise needs the Gaussian-compatible lower experiment, but the theorem statement does not state those envelope conditions.
proof_attempt_summary: D0 developed a publicly calibrated sorted-loading quantile interval and sign frontier, verified three classical citations against primary books, and proved the Bernstein moment inequality directly. D0.5 graded the resulting package subfield below the mandatory field floor and stopped before formalization. Mathematical review remained REVISE: the Gaussian lower experiment needs four envelope conditions that are absent from the legal-mixtures lemma and two unconditional converse statements, so the matched lower-bound claims were not certified.
tldr: For each deterministic public unit loading \(x\), the causal individualized \(1/4\)-quantile contrast \(\theta=x^\top(\beta_1-\beta_0)\) has exact honest connected-interval expected-length and composite-sign detection frontiers \(L_n(x)\asymp D_n(x)\asymp G=(H+sT)/\sqrt n\) in the declared iid randomized common-height sparse quantile class, for all sufficiently large \(n\). The explicit public calibration \(\mathbf c^\star\) is proved and attains these frontiers through the observable four-fold procedure, with estimated arm-specific heights and covariance. At \(q\asymp s^2\log p\), the matched order is \(\sqrt{\log\log p/(n\log p)}\). The claim concerns this model and a deterministic public profile; it does not provide simultaneous post-outcome profile coverage or observational or NHANES validity. Neither this class nor the published Sun--Xia class contains the other as written.
gap: Published IQTE minimaxity covers sparse loadings, whereas arbitrary-loading sequence theory assumes product observations and current Gaussian-regression theory addresses a different adaptive testing criterion with possible logarithmic gaps.
fill: The project joins explicit legal sparse support mixtures to a determinate four-fold estimator family. Its open task is deriving public calibration that certifies the selected-loading score and the resulting honest length and sign frontier.
